highlights.title: Wide screens open things beside Brain
highlights.line: From 1920 wide, a card or a row opens next to the chat, with your Work board beside it.

highlights.title: Every step says what it did
highlights.line: Each command, read and edit shows its target and result, and its time when known.

highlights.title: Claude Code and Codex, any Provider
highlights.line: A Provider of another API just works, and a Fallback answers when one is down.

fixes: On the Mac, updating Mewla in the app restarts it without hanging.
Codex keeps working after Magpie is turned off, and with models a Provider adds later.
Uninstalling Mewla gives Codex and Claude Code back their own settings.
